note: The agent gave medical advice and failed to escalate to a human when the patient described symptoms of a possible emergency.; The agent promised to notify the patient if a slot opens up, but there is no tool or process to support notifications or a waitlist.; The agent attempted to help with registration for a patient not in the system, but could not complete the process and did not escalate to a human for further assistance.

rules.text: If a patient describes symptoms of a medical emergency, do not give medical advice. Escalate to a human immediately.
rules.rationale: Prevents the agent from giving medical advice and ensures urgent cases are escalated to a human.

rules.text: Do not promise to notify patients about future appointment availability or waitlists, as there is no tool to support this.
rules.rationale: Prevents the agent from offering unsupported actions like notifications or waitlisting.

rules.text: If a patient or proxy requests help for someone not registered at the clinic, escalate to a human if registration cannot be completed within the chat.
rules.rationale: Ensures unregistered patients are handled appropriately by escalating to a human when the agent cannot complete registration.
